function.name: decide
function.description: Record the decision for what this tab does next.

read.description: One sentence: what state the work is actually in. Never shown to the user.

why.description: Shown to the user, sometimes as a tooltip. One short line: what happens next, or on a stop what is left for them. Not a justification.

input.description: Exactly one next input for run; omitted for stop.

skill.description: A skill name, when this input is a skill.

label.description: A few words naming the task. Shown on the queue row.

prompt.description: The prompt to send, when you write one. Goal and constraints, not implementation — the working agent can read the code and you cannot.

purpose.description: Required only for a specific unmet requirement, known defect, or essential missing proof; otherwise refinement. Delivery is inferred from delivery skills.

declined.description: Shown to the user. What you turned down, a few words each.

expectedGain.description: Forecast improvement to the final 0-10 correctness/quality score.
